categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai Raysharp Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the security video surveillance industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of security video monitoring hardware and software products. Its main products include front-end cameras (such as AI smart series, PTZ, multi-lens, full-color black light, thermal imaging, and consumer home series) and back-end hard disk video recorders (XVR and AI NVR series). The company serves both consumer markets (homes, communities, enterprises, shops, vehicles) and engineering markets (government agencies, public safety, finance, power, education, utilities, large commercial complexes).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced image processing, audio-video codec, storage, and intelligent analysis technologies. It employs a matrix organizational structure for R&D, integrating resource and product lines to enhance development efficiency. Production follows a 'sales-driven production' model with strict quality control and supplier management. The company emphasizes AI algorithms for intelligent detection, multi-modal fusion, and cloud-edge-end collaboration technologies. It holds 30 valid invention patents and has certifications including ISO9001, ISO27001, and ISO27017, ensuring compliance with international quality and security standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Raysharp serves nearly 500 global customers, including leading technology and consumer electronics brands primarily through an ODM business model. Its products are sold extensively in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, South America, and Africa. Key end markets include consumer residential users, commercial enterprises, government and public safety agencies, financial institutions, power utilities, education, and large commercial complexes. The company also retains a small OBM sales portion targeting domestic Chinese customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province, China, within the Pearl River Delta economic zone, benefiting from proximity to Hong Kong and Macau for international trade. Its sales are predominantly international, with over 92% of revenue from overseas markets including North America, Europe, and Asia. Domestic sales account for approximately 7.7% of revenue, with ongoing efforts to expand the domestic market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Raysharp operates in the midstream segment of the security video surveillance industry supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of security monitoring devices such as cameras and video recorders. It sources key electronic components like optical lenses, chips, image sensors, and storage media from upstream suppliers and sells finished products to downstream system integrators, distributors, and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on AI algorithm development, intelligent scene applications (e.g., personnel tracking, package detection), ultra-wide-angle and multi-lens cameras, thermal imaging, and consumer smart home products. It is developing advanced products such as 4K ultra-wide-angle AI cameras, intelligent wireless PTZ cameras, and solar-powered 4G low-power cameras. The company also invests in cloud-based IoT platforms to enhance device connectivity and management, aiming to strengthen its competitive edge and expand product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Raysharp generates revenue primarily through product sales of security video surveillance hardware, including front-end cameras and back-end recording devices. It also earns income from technical services and system integration solutions. The company mainly operates under an ODM model, designing and manufacturing customized products for global brand customers, with a minor portion of direct sales (OBM) domestically.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Raysharp is recognized as a leading domestic backbone enterprise in security video surveillance with strong technical and production capabilities. It ranks 28th in the 2024 Global Security 50 list by a&s media, indicating a significant global market presence. The company faces competition from other established security video surveillance manufacturers, especially in high-end engineering markets where it currently has fewer products compared to industry leaders. It is actively enhancing its R&D and product portfolio to improve competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 690.7 million, a slight increase of 0.38% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 71.3 million, down 22.89% from the previous year, impacted by US sanctions. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 1.16 billion and net assets of RMB 1.04 billion at year-end. Despite challenges, it continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 84 million, representing over 12% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Raysharp emphasizes advanced image quality with superior color reproduction, clarity, real-time transmission, and stable, secure data storage. Its products integrate AI-powered intelligent analysis for proactive security, including facial recognition, behavior analysis, and multi-modal sensing. The company offers a broad product matrix covering diverse customer needs from consumer to professional engineering applications, supported by international certifications and a flexible ODM model enabling rapid customization and large-scale delivery. Its strategic location and strong supplier relationships further enhance cost control and market responsiveness.
